provenance: Reconstructed from Slope's public product pages and announcements; values between the published anchors are reconstructed.

product.description: Slope pays the supplier directly; the business repays Slope on net terms or in monthly installments, by ACH from its connected account.
product.early_repayment: The fee is prorated to the days the funds were outstanding.
product.funding: Slope pays the supplier on the next business day after approval.
product.terms_basis: Slope's FAQ: pay-later on 30- or 60-day terms, or in installments over 60 or 90 days.

price_card.basis: Fee as a share of the amount financed, by risk tier and term. Tier A's Net 30 fee is the published rate (as low as 1.60% on Net 30, bill-pay page); longer terms and lower tiers are reconstructed from it at a similar monthly rate.

tiering.basis: Risk tier from connected-bank features (reconstructed, in the spirit of SlopeScore). Months of cover = available cash / monthly outflows.

credit_policy.basis: Reconstructed credit policy. Slope sets a pre-approved limit, an order limit (largest single financed invoice), the available terms and the fee for each term; larger, higher-risk or unusual applications go to human exception review.
credit_policy.liquidity_floor_basis: At every scheduled payment date, projected available cash after the payment must stay above one month of operating outflows.
exception_review_triggers: amount above the automated order limit
existing secured lender whose consent may be required
credit_policy.security: Unsecured; existing lenders' negative-pledge or debt covenants must permit the financing.
credit_policy.limit_basis: The limit is the lower of half of monthly bank inflows and 15% of the lowest projected available cash over the horizon.

capital.basis: Reconstructed funding and loss assumptions for lender economics.
